ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Macro-level ratio of high-intensity (white) to low-intensity (black) pixels is approximately 1:4 across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large low-intensity contiguous regions (black) cover the majority of the left and right lobes; a mid-intensity (gray) triangular region is centered at the median notch; localized high-intensity (white) circular blobs are located at the extreme distal boundaries of the fluke tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Calculated V-shaped depression angle of approximately 40 degrees with a bounding-box depth extending ~12% into the fluke longitudinal axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration pattern with pixel amplitudes ranging from 3 to 15 pixels; approximately 13 primary peaks identified across the continuous linear boundary of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical S-curve sweep; concave curvature initiating at the median notch transitioning to convex curvature at the outer 30% of each lobe's horizontal span.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of 4 high-contrast circular clusters at the distal left tip and 3 similar clusters at the distal right tip, identifying localized barnacle colonization sites.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive network of white/light-gray linear disruptions (rake marks) crossing the dark pigment at angles of 45-60 degrees relative to the trailing edge; highest density observed on the mid-section of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple deep-set linear rake marks; barnacle attachment scarring at distal tips; irregular trailing edge geometry indicating historical tissue removal/trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: Localized high-intensity pixel group at the extreme trailing edge of the right lobe, distinct from primary barnacle clusters.
